items.target: The Americans S1E8 BDU107 performer-side action-bearing acquisition records
items.notes: Search only for action-bearing evidence around Sadie/Lana: submission, appointment, callback, pre-read, booking, deal memo, sides, call sheet, casting-session sheet, representative sender, or contemporaneous client/rep state. Episode credits/stills/reviews are controls only and must not count as solving the bridge. Preserve any historically dated page/object carrying BDU107 + casting/rep context.
